selection.basis: Fresh HEAD includes the quality-preserving family/template fast-path contract and peer A00131 only. B00134/B00136 remain producer outputs awaiting C and are excluded. Shared state contains no B-even RENDER_READY/ONE_STAGE_TO_RENDER item. Existing candidate backlog is runtime/dependency/revalidation work. These four older C-consumed pre-generation assets share a front-end family but still lack exact current canonical source bytes, so they are advanced by one legal fallback-4 batch.

acceleration_route.reason: Exact canonical source geometry is unavailable for all four; family similarity cannot authorize geometry/style copying.
acceleration_route.future_route_after_source_acquisition: Evaluate each asset independently for FAST_PATH vs QUALITY_PATH after canonical masks/CLEAN_PLATE/safe bbox exist.
